ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white and 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels. The distribution is characterized by high-intensity lateral lobes and a central low-intensity vertical column extending from the peduncle to the notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone forms a 'butterfly' shape at the pivot, narrowing toward the notch. High-intensity contiguous fields dominate both lobes. Dark pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips and along the serrated trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees. Bounding-box depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitudes vary between 3 and 10 pixels, featuring sharp 'peaks' and 'valleys' that create a distinct saw-tooth silhouette against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex curvature transitioning from the notch to the distal tips. Both lobes exhibit a tapered, upward-sweeping terminal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel-voids (dark rings) are visible: three distinct clusters on the central-left white field and four clusters on the central-right white field, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) are visible on the lower-left lobe. One distinct diagonal high-contrast linear mark is visible on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable concentration of dark pigment spots and small circular scars is localized in the mid-ventral region of the right lobe. Distal tips show heavy wear and irregular pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The left distal tip contains a unique 'hooked' downward-curving pixel-contour not mirrored on the right side.
